newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ICICI to borrow 100 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's ICICI to borrow 100 bln rupees.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) said on Monday it planned to raise 100 billion rupees through rupee borrowings in 1997/98 (April-March) as part of its resource mobilisation.
"We plan to raise 100 billion (rupees) through rupee resources in 1997/98," ICICI managing director K.V Kamath told reporters.
Earlier ICICI announced a 62 percent jump in its 1996/97 net profit to 7.7 billion rupeees, after adjustment for previous year balances.
